# MVP-15 syntax highlight fixtures

Synthetic fixtures for MVP-15 Phase D vitest bench coverage.

- Regenerate: `./scripts/fixtures/generate-syntax-highlight-fixtures.sh`
- Seed: `mvp-15-phase-d-v1` by default; override with `SEED=<value>`.
- Tracked fixtures: `1mb-typescript.ts`, `10mb-typescript.ts`, and `1mb-{rust,python,go,java}`.
- Local-only fixture: `50mb-typescript.ts`, ignored by `.gitignore`.

All fixture content is synthetic template code generated by the script. It does not copy third-party source code.
